title: On Catching the last fish before dusk
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：catch　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 catch 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the counsellor ① caught the last fish before dusk twice over, and every listener in the garden said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three evenings on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the counsellor ② catches the last fish before dusk year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ catch the last fish before dusk at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ caught the last fish before dusk before — a line in the journal for June 1957 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Catching the last fish before dusk twice over, the counsellor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the letter at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ catch the noon train to the city year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Catch the noon train to the city at once and never mention it again.

By 1970 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the journal, and a new listener from the next garden ⑧ catches the noon train to the city twice over every evening without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ caught the last fish before dusk again when nobody else would.

⑩ To catch the last fish before dusk, my mother said in 1975, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the garden remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the garden forgets, somebody catches the last fish before dusk year after year again and somebody must catch the last fish before dusk twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 捉住（一般过去式 caught the last fish before dusk：1963 年谈心人头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 捉住（一般现在 catches the last fish before dusk：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 捉住（不定式 to catch the last fish before dusk：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 捉住（过去完成时 had caught the last fish before dusk：1957 年六月的心记上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 捉住（动名词 catching the last fish before dusk 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 赶上（catch the noon train to the city：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去赶上正午那趟进城的车）
G. v. 赶上（catch the noon train to the city：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 捉住（后段两处：新来的倾听者照例 catches the noon train to the city，而母亲又一次 caught the last fish before dusk）

answers.why: catch 意为“捉住”，1963 年谈心人来回两遍捉住天黑前捉到最后一条鱼，那是小园里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 caught。
catch 意为“捉住”，自那以后谈心人年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 catches。
catch 意为“捉住”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯捉住天黑前捉到最后一条鱼”，此处为不定式 to catch the last fish before dusk。
catch 意为“捉住”，心记里 六月 那行字说明早在 1970 年之前就有人捉住过，故用过去完成时 had caught。
catch 意为“捉住”，谈心人说“捉住天黑前捉到最后一条鱼这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 catching the last fish before dusk 作主语。
catch 意为“赶上”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去赶上正午那趟进城的车”，should ever 之后用原形 catch the noon train to the city。
catch 意为“赶上”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻赶上正午那趟进城的车（catch the noon train to the city at once），以后再也不要提起。
catch 意为“捉住”，新来的倾听者每个黄昏都照例赶上正午那趟进城的车，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 catches。
catch 意为“捉住”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍捉住天黑前捉到最后一条鱼，用一般过去式 caught 叙述。
catch 意为“捉住”，结尾那句是母亲 1975 年的话：要捉住天黑前捉到最后一条鱼，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和小园记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1963 年，谈心人来回两遍捉住天黑前捉到最后一条鱼；小园里每一个倾听者都说这是头一回。（caught the last fish before dusk）
多年以后，谈心人仍年年地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（catches the last fish before dusk）

早在 1957 年就有人捉住天黑前捉到最后一条鱼，六月那天心记上的一行字就是证据。（had caught the last fish before dusk）
谈心人说过，来回两遍捉住天黑前捉到最后一条鱼这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（catching the last fish before dusk 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻赶上正午那趟进城的车，以后再也不要提起。（catch the noon train to the city，祈使句）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 catch 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1963 the counsellor caught the last fish before dusk twice over, and nobody in the garden forgot it.
Even now the counsellor catches the last fish before dusk year after year whenever the garden asks.
Catching the last fish before dusk twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever catch the noon train to the city year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new listener from the next garden catches the noon train to the city twice over every evening, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother caught the last fish before dusk again, and the garden remembered that half.
